lines.trans: Denis, listen, what kind of nonsense is this?
You did not come home for the night, and you are not answering my calls.
Sorry, first I got carried away with work, and then my phone died.
Are you avoiding me?
No, of course I am not avoiding anyone, no.
Excuse me, my baguette is getting cold.
Oh, by the way, I will be working room service all week.
What do you mean all week, Denis?
Katya, where is my herring ice cream?
Nastya, please wait a second.
Denis, what is going on?
Looks like Dan's baguette really went cold.
